blocks.prompt: 10. Fatima invites 14 people to a dinner. There are 9 males and 5 females who are seated at two different tables. Guests of one sex sit at one round table and the guests of the other sex sit at the second table. Find the number of ways in which all guests are seated.
blocks.explanation:
Do alag gol tables hain: ek par 9 mard mehmaan, doosri par 5 khawateen mehmaan.
Plan: har table ki gol tarteebein alag ginein, phir multiply karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 9 mard ek round table par, 5 khawateen doosri round table par.
Humein find karna hai: tamam 14 mehmaanon ke bethne ke tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Har gol table ke liye \((n - 1)!\) (Case-I), phir Fundamental Principle of Counting se multiply.

Mardon ko bithayen
\[(9 - 1)! = 8! = 40320\]
Kyun: 9 mukhtalif log ek gol table par bethe hain. Sab ek seat ghoom jayen to tarteeb wahi rehti hai, is liye ek ko fix kar ke baaqi 8 ko 8! tareeqon se bithate hain.

Khawateen ko bithayen
\[(5 - 1)! = 4! = 24\]
Kyun: 5 mukhtalif khawateen doosri gol table par bethi hain. Yahan bhi ghoomne se tarteeb nahi badalti, is liye ek ko fix kar ke baaqi 4 ko 4! tareeqon se.

Multiply karein
\[8! \times 4! = 40320 \times 24\]
\[= 967680\]
Kyun: Pehli table ki har tarteeb ke saath doosri table ki har tarteeb mil sakti hai; dono tables ek doosre par asar nahi daaltin.
Dhyan dein: \(13!\) lena ghalat hai, kyunke sab ek table par nahi baithe; do alag gol tables hain.

Tasdeeq
\[40000 \times 24 = 960000,\quad 320 \times 24 = 7680\]
\[960000 + 7680 = 967680 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Bari multiplication ko tor kar dobara kiya, wohi jawab. Note: kitab ka jawab dono tables mein farq nahi karta. Agar yeh bhi ginna ho ke mard kaunsi table par bethein (pehli ya doosri), to jawab 2 se multiply hota.
